## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Contract or generated artifact
- [ ] Dashboard, alert, or runbook
- [ ] Fixture, validation, or tooling
- [ ] Example or implementation profile

## Validation

List the commands you ran, or explain why validation is not needed.

```text
make docs-verify
make contracts-verify
make validate-generated
make verify
```

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I edited source contracts before generated artifacts, when applicable.
- [ ] I regenerated artifacts with `make generate`, when applicable.
- [ ] I kept user-facing docs under `docs/` and local notes out of the repo.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, live audit payloads, or customer data.
- [ ] My commits use Conventional Commits and include DCO signoff.
